description: This PHP class 'EmployeeEducation' is part of the OrangeHRM system, specifically within the Report FilterField module. It defines filtering logic for employee education data in reports, including methods for modifying database queries and converting filter values to an array representation.

classes.name: EmployeeEducation
classes.description: Handles filtering of employee education data within report generation, including query modification and value normalization.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Adds filter condition to the query based on the selected education when operator is EQUAL.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns the entity alias used in query joins, here 'education'.

methods.name: toArrayXValue
methods.description: Converts the filter value to an array with id and label if the education exists.
